stem:
Komal writes the place value of each digit in $60.83$ using powers of $10$.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Report the words power of $10$ as the digit $6$.
The value is $60$, because those digits are printed largest before the point.

teacher.key_rationale: Expand each digit by its power of 10: tens, ones, tenths, hundredths. Naming “power of 10” as a digit, putting 8 in the tens place, or keeping only the whole-number part miss decimal place value.
